survey: A burning meteor flying toward the lower left. Main parts: (1) a lumpy grey-brown rock body in three-quarter view, its face toward the camera, with one large crater upper left, one at the right edge, a small crater in the middle and one at the bottom edge. The craters are recessed bowls with raised rims that follow the surface. (2) A trail of three stylized orange flame tongues coming from the upper-right back edge of the rock and streaming back and up, away from the direction of travel. Each flame tapers to a point, with a small droplet just past the tip, the usual cartoon way to draw fire. The flames start along the rock's rear rim and partly overlap it. Nothing else needs support: the rock is in free flight on an abstract background.
